metaTitle: Developers — Meridian | API for Mod Integration
metaDescription: Meridian's stable public API for mod developers: read a table's shelf stats, per-enchantment limits and library contents, roll loot enchantments through the same engine as the table, contribute stats from your own blocks, and react to config reloads — as a soft dependency.
ogDescription: Stable public API for integrating with Meridian's enchanting overhaul.
title: Developers
lede: Meridian exposes a stable, read-only API plus a handful of provider interfaces so other mods can read the enchanting system's state, feed it their own blocks and items, and roll enchantments through the same engine the table uses — without a hard dependency.

html: Compile against Meridian with modCompileOnly so it stays optional at runtime, then guard every call with a mod-loaded check.

blocks.label: Gradle:

html: Guard calls so your mod loads cleanly whether or not Meridian is present:
Static entry points on com.rfizzle.meridian.api.MeridianAPI. Every method is read-only, never throws for a well-formed call, and never returns null.

rows: The clamped shelf stats (Eterna, Quanta, Arcana, Rectification, Clues, blacklist, treasure flag) an enchanting table at that position would scan right now.
Effective max level, max loot level, level cap, power functions and enabled flag for one enchantment, config overrides applied.
The same, for every registered enchantment.
Points stored for one enchantment in the Enchantment Library at that position; empty if the block is not a library.

Roll enchantments for a stack through Meridian's selection engine at the given power, optionally allowing treasure; clamped to each entry's loot cap. Empty when the item is unenchantable or nothing rolls.

html: Implement these on your own blocks and items to take part in Meridian's mechanics. Every call the host makes into them is isolated: a provider that throws is logged once and skipped, and the table, anvil, or reload carries on.

rows: Contributes stats to the table scan and draws its own table particles.
Blacklists enchantments from rolling / unlocks treasure rolls while in range.
Post-processes the enchantment list the table selected for that item.
Fabric event fired server-side at the end of /meridian reload, after config and enchantment info are rebuilt and synced.

items: The API package is com.rfizzle.meridian.api — everything outside it is internal and may change without notice. Types in it are annotated @Stable and hold across patch and minor versions.
rollLootEnchantments needs a ServerLevel; call it from server logic, not client rendering. The other accessors work on either side.
Meridian uses official Mojang mappings (e.g. ServerLevel, ItemStack), matching a standard 1.21.1 Fabric + Loom setup.

html: Building an integration and something's missing? Open an issue — the API surface grows based on real integration needs.
